references.text: The Lord appears to Moses in a burning bush, which can be seen as a parallel to God's glory appearing to the shepherds.
The prophet Isaiah sees the Lord's glory, which can be compared to the glory surrounding the shepherds.
This verse describes how God clothes himself in light like a robe, which may remind one of the glory surrounding the shepherds.
Saul's encounter with Jesus on the way to Damascus, where a light from heaven suddenly shines around him, has similarities with the light of glory that surrounds the shepherds.
The angel who appears to Peter in prison and the light that shines in the cell can be seen as a parallel to the angel's revelation to the shepherds.
